text: Count up in fives starting from 5. What is the eighth number you say?
You buy a dozen eggs and then half a dozen more. How many eggs have you got?
A curling team has four players. How many players take part in a game between two teams?
Americans write the month first. What date do they mean by 10/12?
why: Month 10 is October, and the day is the 12th.

text: A film starts at 7:45pm and lasts 1 hour 50 minutes. What time does it finish?
Two thirds of a class of 30 are girls. How many boys are there?
why: Two thirds of 30 is 20 girls, leaving 10 boys.

text: What is the fewest UK coins you need to make exactly 99p?
How many minutes are there from 11:45pm to 1:15am?
why: 15 minutes to midnight, then 75 more to 1:15: 90 minutes.

text: Today is Sunday. What day of the week was it 1,000 days ago?
why: 1,000 days is 142 weeks and 6 days, and six days before a Sunday is a Monday.

text: Which whole number is exactly twice the sum of its own digits?
why: 1 + 8 = 9, and 2 × 9 = 18. No other whole number (above zero) works.
